data.message:
Stop 'No more trains today' when the legacy shop failed

When the legacy shop fails before the cut-off, the new system's partial list can be empty after the last
departure, which proves nothing. search() no longer adds the end-of-day notice then; the failure notice
stands alone. Test: test_a_legacy_failure_after_the_last_train_... (tests/test_retry.py).

Verified: the new test fails on the base code (the 'No more trains' assertion) and passes with the fix;
flipping or removing the new condition makes it fail. Full suite: 694 passed, 15 skipped, 1 failed:
tests/test_legacy.py::test_cli_search_falls_back_with_exit_0 gets a usage error 'date 2026-11-20 is in the past'
(date-dependent, raised in cli.py before search runs; not changed here).
